gloss: to plan; to plot; to attempt

definitions.gloss: to plan; to scheme; to plot; to attempt
definitions.explanation: To devise or organize a plan, especially something ambitious or secretive. Often implies large-scale plans or schemes, and can carry a negative connotation when used for plots or conspiracies.

examples.japanese: {脱獄|だつごく}を{企|くわだ}てた。
{新|あたら}しいビジネスを{企|くわだ}てている。
examples.english: I am planning a new business venture.

examples.japanese: {反乱|はんらん}を{企|くわだ}てた{者|もの}たちは{全員|ぜんいん}{逮捕|たいほ}された。
examples.english: All those who plotted the rebellion were arrested.

notes:
USAGE:
{企|くわだ}てる often implies planning something significant or secretive. The noun form {企|くわだ}て means a plan or scheme. In business contexts, the related word {企画|きかく} (planning, project) is far more common.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {陰謀|いんぼう}を{企|くわだ}てる (to hatch a conspiracy)
- クーデターを{企|くわだ}てる (to plot a coup)
- {暗殺|あんさつ}を{企|くわだ}てる (to plot an assassination)
- {事業|じぎょう}を{企|くわだ}てる (to plan an enterprise)

RELATED WORDS:
- {企|くわだ}て: plan, scheme (noun)
- {企画|きかく}: planning, project
- {計画|けいかく}する: to plan (neutral)
- たくらむ: to scheme, to conspire
